name: sensortower-scraper
what_it_holds: Python scraper (no listed license, 1 star, last commit Feb 2025) of the public app.sensortower.com pages to collect download-estimate statistics for Android and iOS apps -- i.e. it reads Sensor Tower's free public app-detail pages rather than calling their paid API.
why_useful: Directly targets our gap #5 wish-list item 'AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples' -- if Sensor Tower's public pages still expose download estimates for Airbnb/Booking/Expedia without a paid key, this is a free route to third-party download-estimate numbers (Sensor Tower's own modeled downloads, not just store rank). Small, unmaintained repo -- would need testing/adapting and a ToS check before any run (per repo rules, scraping decision left to a human).
geography: global (per Sensor Tower's own country breakdowns)
time_coverage: current snapshot only; unmaintained since Feb 2025

name: app-store-operator
what_it_holds: MCP server (MIT, 3 stars, updated 25 Jul 2026) billed as 'Free App Store competitive intelligence for Claude -- rival downloads, revenue, and ASO keywords... no subscription.' Wraps public App Store data sources to estimate downloads/revenue/keyword rank for any app, framed for use by an LLM agent.
why_useful: If it genuinely derives download/revenue estimates from free public signals (as advertised) rather than a paid Sensor Tower/data.ai feed, it is a zero-cost way to get modeled download/revenue numbers for Airbnb's app and travel competitors; needs verification of its actual data source before relying on it, and is very small/unverified (3 stars).

name: Google-Playstore-Dataset
what_it_holds: GitHub backup of a Kaggle dataset: 2.3 million Google Play apps x 24 attributes (installs band, rating, rating count, price, category, developer, size, content rating, etc.), collected June 2021, stored as split Part*.csv files to be reassembled; MIT license. Primary/updated copy lives on Kaggle at kaggle.com/gauthamp10/google-playstore-apps (which the author says receives newer refreshes than the GitHub mirror).
why_useful: A full-market snapshot that would include Airbnb's Play Store install-band/rating/review-count as of mid-2021; if multiple dated Kaggle versions of this dataset exist they could be strung into a coarse multi-year install-band/rating panel (gap 5). Single GitHub snapshot alone is not a time series.
time_coverage: June 2021 snapshot (GitHub copy); Kaggle host may have later versions
last_activity: static since ~2021 on GitHub; Kaggle side reportedly updated
size_hint: 2.3M rows, multi-part CSV, likely several hundred MB uncompressed

why_all: A full-market snapshot that would include Airbnb's Play Store install-band/rating/review-count as of mid-2021; if multiple dated Kaggle versions of this dataset exist they could be strung into a coarse multi-year install-band/rating panel (gap 5). name: apple-appstore-apps
what_it_holds: GitHub backup of a Kaggle dataset: ~1.2 million iOS apps x 21 attributes (rating, price, developer, version, genre, etc.), collected October 2021 via Scrapy on cloud VMs, CC BY 4.0 licensed. Kaggle host: kaggle.com/gauthamp10/apple-appstore-apps.
why_useful: Companion iOS-side snapshot to the Play Store dataset above; would carry Airbnb's App Store rating/review-count metadata as of Oct 2021 for a historical anchor point (gap 5).
